answer_1.quote: We train NMT models ... report the ChrF++ scores. ... We use the top-ranked 100k sentence pairs ... to train NMT models (Section 4.4).

answer_2.quote: We report the results using ChrF++ ... ChrF++ was chosen over the conventional multi‑BLEU ... because character‑level evaluation is more suitable for the considered languages.

answer_4.quote: Each sentence pair is annotated by three translators to reduce any potential bias ... The annotators were given the taxonomy definitions and a flow‑chart guideline ...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators followed the taxonomy flowchart and selected the appropriate noise category (CC, CN, CB, CS, CCN, X, UN, WL, NL) for each sentence pair.
